rules.statement: The service button shows the stopped icon for Idle and Stopped, connecting for Connecting, connected for Connected, stopping for Stopping.

examples.given: the service state is Connected
examples.then: the button shows the connected icon

examples.given: the service state is Idle at activity start
examples.when: the activity resets the UI before binding
examples.then: the button shows the stopped icon, replacing the layout's idle drawable

rules.statement: A tap on the service button stops the service when state.canStop is true and starts it otherwise.

examples.given: the service state is Connected
examples.when: the user taps the service button
examples.then: the app broadcasts the CLOSE action and the service begins stopping

examples.given: the service state is Stopped
examples.when: the user taps the service button
examples.then: the app runs the StartService contract instead of stopping

rules.statement: The service button is enabled only when the state can stop or the state is Stopped. On API 24 and later the pointer icon is a hand when the button is enabled and a wait icon when it is disabled.

examples.given: the state is Connected and the device runs API 24 or later
examples.then: the button is enabled and its pointer icon is a hand

examples.given: the state is Stopped and the device runs API 23
examples.then: the button is enabled and the pointer icon stays at the platform default, because the code sets no pointer icon below API 24

examples.given: the state is Idle and the device runs API 24 or later
examples.when: the activity has not yet bound to the service
examples.then: the button is disabled and its pointer icon is a wait icon

examples.given: the state is Stopping
examples.then: the button is disabled, so a second stop cannot be requested

rules.statement: The service button is checked, and therefore drawn with the green background, only when the state is Connected.

examples.given: the state becomes Connected
examples.then: state_checked is merged and the background uses material_green_700

examples.given: the state becomes Connecting
examples.then: state_checked is absent and the background uses material_primary_500

rules.statement: The service button content description and tooltip read Stop when the state can stop, and Connect otherwise.

examples.given: the state is Connected
examples.then: the content description and tooltip read Stop

examples.given: the state is Stopped
examples.then: the content description and tooltip read Connect

rules.statement: In Connecting the progress ring shows as indeterminate after the medium animation time plus one second, once the activity is started. The delay runs first and does not pause. An activity that starts after the delay sees the ring at once.

examples.given: the state becomes Connecting and the activity is started
examples.when: the medium animation time plus 1000 ms pass
examples.then: the ring becomes indeterminate and shows

examples.given: the state becomes Connecting and then Connected before the medium animation time plus 1000 ms
examples.when: the delayed animation has not fired
examples.then: the ring never becomes indeterminate

examples.given: the state becomes Connecting while the activity is stopped
examples.when: the medium animation time plus 1000 ms pass and then the activity starts
examples.then: the ring becomes indeterminate and shows as soon as the activity is started

rules.statement: On Connected the progress ring animates to full and hides when the spring animation ends.

examples.given: the state becomes Connected
examples.then: progress is set to 1 with animation and the ring hides after the animation

examples.given: the state leaves Connecting for Stopping
examples.then: the delayed indeterminate animation is cancelled and the ring hides

rules.statement: Starting in VPN mode asks for system consent only when VpnService.prepare returns an intent, and a denied consent shows the permission denied snackbar.

examples.given: the service mode is VPN and VpnService.prepare returns an intent
examples.when: the user allows the consent dialog
examples.then: Core.startService starts the foreground service and no snackbar shows

examples.given: the service mode is VPN and VpnService.prepare returns null because consent was already granted
examples.then: Core.startService runs at once and no dialog opens

examples.given: the service mode is VPN and the consent dialog is shown
examples.then: the app shows the snackbar Permission denied to create a VPN service

rules.statement: The stats bar is shown only while the state is Connected; it hides when the list scrolls up and returns when the list scrolls down.

examples.then: hideOnScroll becomes true and the bar performs a show animation

examples.given: the state becomes Stopped
examples.then: the bar performs a hide animation

examples.then: the bar hides but stays connected

examples.when: the nested scroll reports a negative consumed distance
examples.then: the bar slides back up

examples.then: the status reads Connecting…

examples.given: the state is Stopping
examples.then: the status reads Shutting down…

examples.given: the state is Stopped

examples.then: the status reads Testing…

examples.given: the state is Stopped

examples.then: no test starts

rules.statement: A service mode change disconnects the activity from the old service class and binds to the new class. The new service reports its own state, which can be Connecting, Connected, Stopping or Stopped. The activity renders that state and does not set Idle.

examples.when: the public preference store reports the serviceMode key
examples.then: the activity disconnects and connects again, binds to ProxyService and renders its Stopped state without an Idle reset

examples.when: the new binding reports its state
examples.then: the activity renders Connected again without an Idle reset

examples.given: any other preference key changes
examples.then: the connection is unchanged

rules.statement: A state change carrying a message shows it as a snackbar; onServiceDisconnected resets the UI to Idle, while onBinderDied only rebinds.

examples.given: the UI shows Idle before the first binding returns and Data.state is Stopped
examples.then: the start contract runs and the service starts, although the service button is disabled

examples.then: the test starts but no status observer shows its result

cases.title: Connect with the VPN consent granted
preconditions: At least one profile is stored and selected
VpnService.prepare returns a consent intent, because the VPN permission has not been granted

notes: All listed files exist. U01 owns layout_main.xml, navigation_header.xml, navigation_main.xml, ToolbarFragment.kt, ServiceButton.kt, StatsBar.kt, FabProgressBehavior.kt, WindowInsetsListeners.kt, Core.kt and BaseService.kt. The toolbar's own menu (profile_manager_menu.xml) and the search field belong to U02, so only the toolbar's navigation icon and title are listed here. The menu XML declares checkableBehavior=single for the main and misc groups. Material 1.13.0's NavigationMenuPresenter calls setExclusiveCheckable(false) on every checkable item, so the groups are not exclusive. The presenter still tracks one checked item for the whole drawer. Selecting About unchecks Profiles, and the reverse also holds. The FAQ item is declared not checkable. NavigationView saves the checked item through NavigationMenuPresenter, and DrawerLayout saves the open state, so a recreated activity restores both. MainActivity forces Profiles only when savedInstanceState is null. Selecting FAQ opens a custom tab and leaves the drawer open. BaseService.onStartCommand returns unless Data.state is Stopped. A Ctrl+G start while the UI shows Idle can start a Stopped service. Ctrl+G while Connecting or Connected sends CLOSE and stops the service. Ctrl+G while Stopping launches a start that the service ignores because Data.state is not Stopped. VpnService.onRevoke calls stopRunner. The RELOAD broadcast calls forceLoad, which stops and restarts a running service and starts a stopped one. Only a guarded process that exits within one second of starting stops the service. A later exit is logged and the process restarts. A service mode change disconnects and rebinds. The new service reports its own state, which can be Connecting, Connected, Stopping or Stopped. The activity does not set Idle. StatsBar.changeState sets the status text before the hide animation starts. Shutting down… and Not connected are visible while the bar slides out. Connecting… is set while the bar is already hidden, so it is not visible. Core.updateNotificationChannels creates VPN Service, Proxy Service, Transproxy Service and Subscription Service channels and deletes service-nat. Those channels are system surfaces covered by U11, not here. The HarmonyOS port has no drawer: the main page shows the app name, a gear that opens Settings (custom rules and About live there) and a plus menu that offers Subscriptions. FAQ has no counterpart. Parity was checked against entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets and Settings.ets: the HarmonyOS connect control is a full-width button whose text switches between Connect and Disconnect, the traffic area is two text lines, the connection test and speed test are separate buttons, and there is no progress ring and no hide-on-scroll.
